name: Dial Thermostat
description: A round dial you turn by dragging, scrolling or with the arrow keys, its arc running from water blue at the cold end to camellia at the hot end.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called each time the dial passes a step.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called when a drag, wheel step or key press ends.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Value at the cold end of the arc.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Value at the hot end of the arc.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment between detents. Its decimals set how the value is written.

props.name: unit
props.description: Written after the value. °C and °F are also read out as Celsius and Fahrenheit.

props.name: coldColor
props.description: Colour of the arc at the cold end.

props.name: hotColor
props.description: Colour of the arc at the hot end.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the dial in pixels, at least 160. Everything scales with it except the end labels, which stay at 12px so they remain legible.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Overrides how the value is announced. By default it follows unit and step.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the dial and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Slider.
